**Security: pass-with-notes** at `738bd91b084311381796ba37bcd17b82535d8fd9`, under C33/C34.

The three shipped schemas match their canonical copies byte-for-byte, use local pij schema targets and introduce no external schema source or private-content disclosure. The subject documentation is conditional on the explicitly required F156 merge order.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | No scoped security vulnerabilities found | - |

## Copies and privacy

The complete seven-file delta was read. PRD, blueprint and workstream schema copies each equal `.dd/schemas/pij/<name>/schema.json`. Their links target local `pij/prd`, `pij/blueprint` or `pij/workstream` sections, not remote URLs or executable hooks.

The drift gate checks all three fixed names with quoted `cmp` paths and sets the check's failure state on a mismatch. Biome excludes only the shipped-copy subtree to preserve canonical bytes; that does not disable the explicit equality check.

No changed-head secrets, private owner/name identities, private source content or outside-product machine paths were found. This is C19/C21 current-head/forward privacy grading, not history rewriting.

## Sequencing and follow-ups

The new subject refusal is not implemented by these docs/schema changes. **Merge after the F156 bundle**, as stated in Known limits, before treating the new subject documentation as current shipped behavior. This verdict does not independently certify that bundle's implementation.

The #202 incremental list flags are explained in prose rather than incorrectly claimed unsupported. The printed-help/coverage limitation and unshipped historical `pij/roadmap` example remain disclosed follow-ups.

**C34 follow-up:** quote the complete schema-copy source argument when substituting the schematic `<pij skill dir>`, so a skill installation path containing spaces remains one shell word. No new shell launch or runtime privilege path is introduced by the schema copies.

## Evidence

Local/remote/GitHub heads agree; shared detached worktree clean; PR CLEAN. CI [42573909313](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42573909313) succeeded on merge `9104a9d7e2a4725484531c84eed1c854c8fb5ee3`, with this head and main `f7744c5c3f677732af8b3c0a4dad657544811ce0` as parents; tree `c58b1b238b92f6f54daf926352ba545ea134fee7`.

The actual `check (24)` job explicitly reports all three schema-copy equality checks passing. Rust CI reports 2,339 passing tests and six separately skipped; Node/Rust/Delivers checks succeed. The scratch-repo validation and one-byte failing control are author evidence, not independently rerun tests here.

The helper returned no assessment; supporting judgment rests on direct scoped source/schema inspection and CI. No local product tests/builds, mutation or scratch validation runs, credential reads, live-system probes or product edits.
